papers.title: Cost-Effectiveness of FF/UMEC/VI vs BUD/GLY/FOR in Moderate-to-Very Severe COPD.
papers.abstract: COPD is a significant cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide and in Colombia. Although single-inhaler triple therapies have demonstrated superior clinical benefits in patients with previous exacerbations, their economic value in middle-income settings remains uncertain. Our objective was to evaluate the long-term cost-effectiveness of fluticasone furoate/umeclidinium/vilanterol (FF/UMEC/VI) versus budesonide/glycopyrronium/formoterol (BUD/GLY/FOR) in Colombian patients with COPD. We developed an individual-level microsimulation model to compare FF/UMEC/VI with BUD/GLY/FOR from the Colombian public payer perspective. The model incorporated GOLD-based progression, exacerbations, mortality, dynamic adherence functions, costs, and utilities derived from a Colombian cohort study. FF/UMEC/VI increased QALYs by 0.51 and saved USD 1,038 per patient, remaining dominant across deterministic and probabilistic sensitivity analyses. Net monetary benefit (NMB) was higher with FF/UMEC/VI. After 10,000 microsimulations, FF/UMEC/VI showed > 95% probability of cost-effectiveness at Colombia's willingness to pay of USD 5,180/QALY. This is the first economic evaluation of FF/UMEC/VI and BUD/GLY/FOR in Colombia, incorporating local real-world data and adherence. Results demonstrate that FF/UMEC/VI is a cost-effective and often dominant option, supporting its adoption in resource-limited settings.
papers.summary: 本研究從哥倫比亞公共支付者角度出發，透過個體層面微模擬模型，比較FF/UMEC/VI與BUD/GLY/FOR兩種單一吸入器三聯療法在中度至極重度COPD患者中的長期成本效益。模型結合了當地真實世界數據與動態依從性函數，結果顯示FF/UMEC/VI不僅能增加0.51個品質調整生命年（QALYs），每位患者還能節省1,038美元，在確定性與機率敏感性分析中均呈現絕對優勢。
papers.significance: 這是哥倫比亞首項結合當地臨床數據與用藥依從性來評估此兩類COPD三聯療法經濟價值的研究。結果證實FF/UMEC/VI具有高度成本效益，為中低收入且資源有限的醫療環境下，優先採用更具經濟優勢的COPD治療方案提供了強有力的實證支持與決策依據。

papers.title: Study of the direct medical economic burden of patients with healthcare-associated infection based on DRGs matching.
papers.abstract: To discuss the direct economic burden of Healthcare-associated Infection (HAI) in a hospital in Chengdu. All patients enrolled in the Diagnosis Related Groups (DRGs) comprehensive evaluation and management system between January 1 and December 31, 2023, were categorized into two groups: those with a Healthcare-associated Infection (HAI) and those without. A 1:1 case matching was performed based on DRG classification, sex, and age (± 5 years). Differences in direct medical costs and length of stay (LOS) between the two groups were compared, followed by a subgroup analysis of infection-related economic burden across diagnostic categories. The HAI incidence rate was 0.92%, and the HAI rate per 1,000 patient days was 1.23‰ in 2023. 726 pairs of HAI cases and non-HAI cases were successfully matched. The direct cost of the HAI group was CNY 16,251.63(13244.10 ~ 19259.16) higher than the non-HAI group (1.91 times higher, P < 0.001). The length of hospital stay in the HAI group was 10(8.58 ~ 11.42) days longer (1.71 times higher, P < 0.001), with significant cost increases in treatment fees and Western medicine (P < 0.001). Among all Major Diagnostic Categories (MDCs), the infection and parasitic diseases group incurred the largest economic burden. For HAI patients with sepsis or severe sepsis requiring ≥ 96 h of mechanical ventilation, the total cost was CNY 80,162.31(27439.11 ~ 132885.51) higher than non-HAI patients (P = 0.003), and hospitalization duration increased by 17.5(5.99 ~ 29.01) days (P = 0.003). In conclusion, implementing scientifically classified DRGs in HAI management provides a strategic framework for advancing precision-oriented healthcare administration.
papers.summary: 本研究以成都某醫院2023年納入DRGs系統的患者為對象，透過1:1匹配（依DRG分類、性別、年齡）對比726對有無醫療保健相關感染（HAI）患者的直接醫療成本與住院天數。結果顯示，HAI組直接醫療費用較非HAI組平均高出16,251.63人民幣（為其1.91倍），住院天數延長10天（為其1.71倍），主要增加的成本來自治療費與西藥費。其中，感染及寄生蟲病類別的經濟負擔最大，若合併敗血症並需長期機械通氣，其成本與住院天數的增幅更為顯著。
papers.significance: 該研究精確量化了HAI帶來的額外直接經濟負擔，證實了科學運用DRGs分類系統能夠有效評估不同疾病類別下的感染成本差異。此結果不僅為醫院制定精準的感染控制預算與決策提供了確切的數據支撐，也突顯了透過DRGs管理框架推動精準醫療行政管理與優化醫療資源配置的戰略價值。

papers.title: Rapid assessment of the implementation of national health insurance program in Nepal: a qualitative study.
papers.abstract: Nepal's national health insurance program (NHIP) initiative, launched in 2016, endeavors to attain universal health coverage (UHC). However, it encounters significant hurdles in ensuring sufficient coverage across the population. Despite the remarkable progress it has made in improving access to health services, there are problems resulting into poor enrollment and retention and challenges regarding ensuring quality of care. This study aimed to assess the current implementation challenges of NHIP through consumer and providers perspectives and thereby identify the facilitators and barriers for enrollment in NHIP. We conducted an exploratory qualitative research design and employed thematic analysis approach. A total of 22 health facilities across the 14 districts of 3 provinces of Nepal were included in the study. We conducted 62 key informant interviews with the providers and 39 focus group discussions with the community members to determine the factors impacting enrollment and retention to health insurance program. All the interviews were audio-recorded, translated and analyzed thematically using the WHO six-building blocks as a theoretical framework. The analysis was done in Excel. The results are presented under the WHO six building blocks. The Health Insurance Board's (HIB) leadership lacks effectiveness due to the limited administrative delegation power held by provincial and local governments. The existing financing mechanism is viewed as unsustainable in the long term, highlighting the necessity for mandatory population enrollment. Poor awareness of the program and mistrust regarding care quality emerge as primary factors contributing to low enrollment and retention rates. Addressing these challenges requires urgent implementation of training and retention strategies for community-level enrollment assistants. Additionally, facility-based monitoring and supervision, currently lacking, could serve as a means to improve and rebuild trust in the quality of healthcare service. With rigorous monitoring and iterative approach, Nepal has a historic opportunity to create a model of success on universal health coverage in a low-income setting.
papers.summary: 本研究透過質性方法評估尼泊爾自2016年推行的國家健康保險計畫（NHIP）之實施挑戰。基於世界衛生組織（WHO）六大建構塊框架，研究發現該計畫在邁向全民健康覆蓋（UHC）的過程中，面臨領導力與權力下放不足、融資機制不可持續、以及民眾對計畫認知偏低與對醫療品質缺乏信任等核心障礙，導致保險登記率與保留率低落。
papers.significance: 該研究為低收入國家推動全民健康覆蓋提供了重要的實證基礎與策略指引。透過釐清影響保險參與率的關鍵因素，研究強調強化基層登記人員培訓、落實醫療機構監測與建立強制性參保機制的迫切性。這不僅有助於尼泊爾優化其健康保險制度，更能為其他發展中地區在有限資源下建立可持續的醫療融資模式提供成功典範。

papers.title: Feasibility of mainstreaming schistosomiasis and soil transmitted helminthiasis mass drug administration into primary healthcare: a baseline survey for a community case study in Western Kenya.
papers.abstract: Mass drug administration campaigns have enabled great progress in the prevention and control of schistosomiasis and soil transmitted helminthiasis. However, the persistence of these infections continues to challenge public health systems despite decades of control efforts. This study was commissioned to evaluate the feasibility of a transition from periodic mass drug administration campaigns to a sustainable, facility- and community-based delivery model in Western Kenya. The study is part of a non-randomized, controlled before-and-after study using a mixed-methods approach. Data were collected from 1,229 households, 24 health facilities (12 control, 12 intervention), focus group discussions, and key informant interviews. The analysis focused on six domains of mainstreaming feasibility: perception of mainstreaming among key stakeholders, processes, infrastructure and system readiness, acceptability and trust for primary healthcare-led treatment, facilitators, and barriers. Finally, we calculated a composite readiness index to grade facility readiness. Generally, community perceptions to schistosomiasis and soil-transmitted helminthiasis treatment benefits were found to be high in both the control and intervention groups. Qualitative data showed enhanced trust in the integrated model by virtue of the credibility and professional nature of health facility staff. An overwhelming majority of community members received treatment through household visits (95.5%) implying reliance on periodic MDA at baseline. Community Health Promoters remain a critical source of information on treatment opportunities for low-literacy populations, while media and health facilities are increasingly important among more educated groups. We also found high infrastructural and systemic readiness for treatment mainstreaming with respect to stock availability and data reporting systems. However, stock outs were reported among the facilities. High variability in health worker training coverage suggests a critical challenge in workforce preparedness. The findings point to a strong foundation for mainstreaming but underscore the need for a structured implementation package. Priority actions should include standardized operating procedures, supply chain and digital system strengthening, and expanded Community Health Promoter-led outreach activities to improve consistency, access, and sustainability of deworming services within primary healthcare platforms. Registration number NCT07507461, prospectively registered on 28th January, 2026.
papers.summary: 本研究旨在評估肯亞西部將血吸蟲病與土壤傳播蠕蟲感染的大規模藥物投予（MDA）轉型為基層醫療常規服務的可行性。透過涵蓋1229戶家庭、24個醫療機構及質性訪談的混合方法，研究發現社區對治療益處的認知度高，且因醫護人員的專業性而對整合模式展現高度信任。儘管基線調查顯示高達95.5%的民眾仍依賴傳統MDA的家庭訪視，且基礎設施與數據系統具備一定準備度，但仍面臨藥物斷貨與醫護人員培訓覆蓋率差異過大等挑戰。
papers.significance: 此研究為發展中國家從週期性MDA運動過渡至可持續的基層醫療整合模式提供了重要的實證基礎。研究結果不僅揭示了轉型過程中的系統性準備度與潛在障礙，更具體指出了制定標準作業程序、優化供應鏈管理及擴展社區衛生推廣員外展服務等優先行動，對於提升驅蟲服務的可及性、一致性與長期可持續性具有重要指導意義。

papers.title: Public distrust in physicians and healthcare utilization: a nationwide study in China.
papers.abstract: Public distrust in physicians constitutes a significant barrier to effective healthcare utilization, particularly in China, where physician-patient tensions are well-documented. This study analyzed the association between public distrust in physicians and healthcare utilization in China. Utilizing a longitudinal nationally representative dataset from the 2012-2022 China Family Panel Studies, the final sample consisted of 168,174 observations. This study employed a two-way fixed-effects logistic regression analysis within the framework of Andersen's Behavioral Model to examine the association between distrust and healthcare utilization, while controlling for predisposing characteristics, enabling resources, and need factors. Rural areas exhibited a higher outpatient service utilization rate than urban areas. Urban inpatient service utilization rates rose annually from 9.43% in 2012 to 12.36% in 2018, surpassing rural rates, before falling to 9.71% in 2022, below rural levels. Rural residents who reported higher levels of public distrust in physicians showed a lower odds of accessing outpatient care (OR: 0.98, 95% CI: 0.96-0.99). Urban residents who reported higher levels of public distrust in physicians showed a lower odds of accessing inpatient care (OR: 0.97, 95% CI: 0.95-0.99). Higher public distrust in physicians was associated with reduced outpatient care access among rural residents and diminished inpatient care access among urban residents. Improving physician-patient trust is a critical policy priority in China. Targeted policy interventions, including strengthening physician-patient trust in rural grassroots clinics, improving the quality of urban inpatient services, and promoting the balanced allocation of medical resources, are needed so as to narrow the urban-rural trust gap and promote the equitable and rational use of medical services.
papers.summary: 本研究利用2012至2022年中國家庭追蹤調查的16.8萬筆全國性樣本數據，基於安德森行為模型分析公眾對醫生的不信任與醫療保健利用率的關聯。研究發現，較高的不信任度會顯著降低農村居民的門診就醫幾率以及城市居民的住院就醫幾率。此外，城鄉醫療利用率呈現動態變化，城市住院率在2018年達到峰值後於2022年回落，且被農村地區反超。
papers.significance: 此研究實證量化了醫患信任缺失對城鄉醫療資源利用的差異化負面影響，凸顯了修復醫患關係在促進醫療公平中的核心地位。其結論為中國制定精準的衛生醫療政策提供了關鍵依據，特別是指出需針對農村基層診所重建信任，並提升城市住院服務品質，以有效縮小城鄉醫療差距並實現資源的合理配置。

papers.title: Sensory encoding of emotion conveyed by the face and visual context.
papers.abstract: Humans rapidly detect and interpret sensory signals that have emotional meaning. The posterior superior temporal sulcus (pSTS) and amygdala are known to be critical for this ability, but their precise contributions remain contentious. Here we investigate how these structures process visual emotional cues using artificial neural networks (ANNs) to model fMRI signal acquired as human participants view complex, naturalistic stimuli. Characterizing data from two archival studies (Ns = 20, 45), we evaluated whether representations from ANNs optimized to recognize emotion from facial expressions alone or the broader visual scene differ in their ability to predict brain responses. We found that abstract representations of facial expressions were more strongly encoded in pSTS than the amygdala, whereas representations of the broader emotional scene were robustly encoded in both regions. These findings demonstrate how the pSTS operates on abstract representations of facial expressions to a greater extent than the amygdala, which more strongly encodes the broader emotional significance of visual information, depending on the context.
papers.summary: 本研究利用人工神經網路（ANN）建模fMRI信號，探討後上顳溝（pSTS）與杏仁核在處理視覺情感線索時的不同作用。研究分析兩項檔案資料發現，僅針對面部表情優化的ANN表徵在pSTS中的編碼強度大於杏仁核；而針對更廣泛視覺情境優化的ANN表徵則在pSTS與杏仁核中皆展現出強健的編碼。結果顯示pSTS主要處理面部表情的抽象表徵，而杏仁核則更強烈地依賴情境來編碼視覺資訊的整體情感意義。
papers.significance: 此研究釐清了pSTS與杏仁核在情感處理機制上的長期爭議，證實大腦處理情感線索的方式會隨視覺情境的不同而產生差異。這項發現不僅深化了對人類情感感知神經迴路的理解，也為未來利用計算模型解碼複雜自然刺激下的大腦活動提供了重要的方法論參考。

papers.title: Neural Correlates of Metamemory Judgments in Worry: An ERP Study.
papers.abstract: It is known that worry is associated with reduced efficiency in metamemory and metacognitive processes, yet the neural underpinnings of this relationship remain unclear. This study compared event-related potentials (ERP) during judgment of learning (JOL) and feeling of knowing (FOK) judgments in participants with high and low levels of worry. Participants' (N = 51) metamemory judgments were measured within an episodic memory task context. Although recognition memory and relative accuracy were similar between groups, significant differences were observed in metacognitive efficiency and bias. The high-worry (HW) group exhibited significantly lower confidence relative to their actual performance and reduced metacognitive efficiency compared to the low-worry (LW) group. Furthermore, HW group exhibited significantly larger P200 amplitudes compared to the LW group, whereas the LW group showed larger N200 amplitudes during both JOL and FOK judgments. The findings support the view that increased levels of worry are associated with heightened inefficiencies in mental processing and cognitive monitoring.
papers.summary: 本研究透過事件相關電位（ERP）探討不同擔憂程度者在元記憶判斷（如學習判斷JOL與知曉感FOK）時的神經機制。結果顯示，雖然高、低擔憂組在再認記憶與相對準確度上無顯著差異，但高擔憂組的信心水準顯著低於實際表現，且元認知效率較差。在腦電波數據上，高擔憂組在進行元記憶判斷時呈現較大的P200振幅，而低擔憂組則呈現較大的N200振幅。
papers.significance: 此研究從神經生理學角度揭示了擔憂情緒導致認知監控與心理處理效率低下的腦電波特徵。這不僅深化了對焦慮與元認知障礙之間關聯的理解，也為未來針對高焦慮或高擔憂個體開發精準的認知行為干預策略提供了客觀的神經科學依據。
